name: duckling_crest_puff_mk2b
rationale: Round-1 diagnosis: attempt-0 hit a null-shape CAD failure; attempt-1's recipe (47de lineage) was geometrically valid (all lowest-Z values positive and inside the 3 mm base: center puff ~+0.19 mm, side ~+1.4 mm, front ~+1.9 mm) but was rejected on a STEP-vs-CAD volume mismatch of ~0.8%, likely a tolerance/boolean artifact. Revision: resubmit the accepted enlarged friendly three-puff silhouette with slight size adjustments (center puff 15x12x10 at z=6.8, -10deg tilt, lowest Z ~0.1 mm fully inside the base; side puffs 10x6x7 at [-2.5,4,6], mirrored from Y>=0; front accent 7x5x5 at [4,3,5]) and a simpler rotation set to reduce boolean complexity. Renders confirm the round-0 crest was connected, clear of the camera lens and front dome, and merely too small; this keeps the doubled presence while staying soft, rounded and well inside 80x80x35 mm and 16 g. Adhesive attachment, curvature fit, printability and walking remain open per the brief.
